GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and contacted. Raced keenly in the early stages. Laid in under pressure in the home straight. When asked to comment on the performance, Jockey could offer no tangible explanation and that the gelding proved disappointing. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Trainer subsequently reported on Sunday, 11 May 2025 that the gelding had pulled up satisfactorily.
